verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a payments platform that handles customer data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers payments, payouts, refunds, chargebacks, notifications and authentication, but nothing documents retention settings or a way to delete customer or transaction data. Refunds and Pix returns are financial reversals, not data deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
